title: Figure 37: contour plot of real component of acoustic pressure, radiating sphere EPW=50
description: ANSYS 12.1 contour plot of the real component of pressure (Pa) for 1,000 Hz with 50 elements per wavelength in water, labeled 'Uniformly Radiating Sphere, EPW=50.' Concentric blue-green pressure rings with legend from -258 to 1103 Pa. Mesh-refinement comparison case in the BAASS acoustic study.
